instruction: Write a complete XDP/eBPF C program that parses 802.1Q VLAN tagged frames (EtherType 0x8100). If the encapsulated packet is IPv4 TCP destined for port 8080, drop it. Untagged packets and non-8080 traffic must be passed.
requirements: Check bounds for Ethernet, VLAN, IPv4, and TCP headers
Apply correct byte order conversions using bpf_htons

tests.name: positive_vlan_8080_drop
tests.description: VLAN tagged IPv4 TCP dport=8080 should be dropped

tests.name: negative_vlan_80_pass
tests.description: VLAN tagged IPv4 TCP dport=80 should pass

tests.name: negative_untagged_8080_pass
tests.description: Untagged IPv4 TCP dport=8080 should pass

tests.name: negative_vlan_udp_pass
tests.description: VLAN tagged IPv4 UDP packet should pass

tests.name: boundary_short_vlan_pass
tests.description: Truncated VLAN packet (<18 bytes) should safely pass
